During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] created a '''base''' on a [[Unidentified moon (Werta system)|moon]] in the [[Werta system/Legends|Werta system]]. Shortly after the base's establishment, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered it and launched an [[Assault on the Werta system moon|assault]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] housing the base.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
